name: DESAR Grade Configuration
description: Grade configuration child table for DESAR Settings. Defines all grades, their valuation percentages, target warehouses, and item suffixes. Adding a row here makes a new grade available across the entire system.

fields.label: Grade Code
fields.description: Short code used in item names. e.g. A, B, C, D

fields.label: Label
fields.description: Display name. e.g. Premium, Standard, Export, Scrap

fields.label: Valuation %
fields.description: % of Grade A valuation rate. Grade A = 100, Grade B = 60, Scrap = 5

fields.label: Target Warehouse
fields.description: Where this grade's finished stock goes after Repack

fields.label: Item Suffix
fields.description: Suffix appended to base item code. e.g. -A, -B, -C. Leave blank for scrap items.

fields.label: Scrap Item
fields.description: Fixed scrap item to use in Repack SE. Only fill for is_scrap grades.

fields.label: Is Scrap
fields.description: If checked, uses scrap_item instead of suffix-based item derivation
